scope: Unified Tanita calendars 2025–2026; 183 manual date/icon labels

calendar_shadow.note: Candidates are associations with expert PDF, not forecast accuracy.

manual_icon_holdout.note: This measures icon recognition, not a decision rule.

prospective.note: Only independently observed outcomes count; expert PDF is not an outcome.

residual_holdout.note: No positive chronological gain; no Tanita coefficient may be promoted.

nonlinear.note: Multiple testing remains unresolved; score effect stays zero.

next_allowed_step: Pre-register a small fixed rule set, freeze predictions before each day, then collect 100 independent real outcomes without changing coefficients.
